description: This file defines a React component 'MapBox' for rendering an interactive map with clustering and overlays, using 'react-map-gl' and related libraries. It includes interface definitions, default properties, and rendering logic.

classes.name: MapBox
classes.description: A React component for rendering a map with clustering and overlays, supporting viewport changes and custom styling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the MapBox component, setting initial viewport based on bounds or default values.

methods.name: handleViewportChange
methods.description: Updates the component state and calls external callback when the viewport changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the MapGL component with overlays and clustering based on current state and props.
